text: paper makes -paper claim das_type normalized value "paper" (washdev style) contains stock phrasing "included paper" / "included article" (IWA journal snapshots keep raw sentence das_type). Papers without claim get NA. Claims classified strongest attachment carry data, using format tiers score_fair(): "open supplement": open machine-readable format attached (csv, txt, tsv, json, xml). "structured supplement": structured proprietary formats (xlsx, xls, docx, doc, sav, dta, rds, parquet). "unstructured supplement": supplement exists pdf images, format unknown. "supplement": nothing attached; claim rests entirely printed tables figures. classification structural: says claimed data , whether actually . title: Score a paper's data management against the FAIR principles — score_fair
text: four dimensions scored follows. Findable (persistent identifier registered location): 2: data registered repository (das_repo_name set) repository link dataset DOI present. 1: data location stated (das_type "available online repository", das_repo_url present) without recognised repository, data paper supplement. 0: data location (DAS, "request", "shareable"). Accessible (can reader get data without barrier): 2: repository supplement link present (das_repo_url supp_url), data directly retrievable. 1: data stated paper supplement link recorded. 0: "request", "shareable", DAS. Interoperable (open, machine-readable shared formats), supp_file_type: 2: open machine-readable format (csv, txt, tsv, json, xml). 1: structured proprietary formats (xlsx, docx, sav, dta). 0: unstructured (pdf, images), shared files. Reusable (license repository metadata). license column yet collected datasets, dimension scored repository signal lower bound: 2: data recognised repository (das_repo_name set), normally carries license rich metadata. 1: data location stated recognised repository. 0: shared data. license column added (see issue #19), raise dimension use directly. Note Accessible scores shared files, authors' intent. paper whose das_type "request" "shareable" can still score 2 Accessible ships supplement supp_url, supplement directly retrievable. das_type value stays visible alongside score, restricted-data paper still shares supplement distinguishable fully open one.
